xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5498: pan start --plan auto --host: work agent never auto-starts after planning (host override lost; no handoff after finalize timeout)

plan.title: pan start --plan auto --host: work agent never auto-starts after planning (host override lost; no handoff after finalize timeout)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After `pan start <id> --plan auto --host --yes` finalizes planning, the work agent does not always start. Cause 1: the --host override reaches the planning start but not the finalize-time spawn request or the deacon-lite retries, so POST /api/agents runs the stack-health gate and refuses with 422 start_blocked_stack_unhealthy when the workspace has no healthy Docker stack. Cause 2: when the spawn request is in flight (for example during a slow stack rebuild) and the dashboard restarts, nothing is journaled, so deacon-lite has nothing to resume.
narratives.Proposal: Record the operator-confirmed host override on the v2 auto-spawn consent record when planning starts with --host, and let the spawn route honor it for consent-bearing requests (first handoff and deacon-lite retries). Journal `handoff.requested` before complete-planning sends the spawn POST, journal `handoff.abandoned` (outcome failed) on a plain failure, and let deacon-lite resume a trailing `handoff.requested` after 10 minutes on the existing backoff, standing down when the operator already started the agent.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the stack-health gate itself or its rebuild behavior
- No host override for spawn requests that carry no auto-spawn consent
- No fix for the readAutoSpawnOnFinalize legacy-field bug in plan-finalize.ts
- No fix for the stale 'deacon will complete promotion' CLI message
- No change to the deacon-lite pass cadence

The start-planning route rejects a mismatched phrase with 409 host_override_confirmation_required and passes hostOverride to spawnPlanningSession, which writes it on the consent record (null when absent).
